items.name: Trend rider
items.author: Moskowitz · Ooi · Pedersen / AQR
items.rule: Use an asset's own past excess return to determine its trend exposure.

items.name: Relative winners
items.author: AQR research
items.rule: Rank assets by their performance relative to peers over a defined lookback.

items.name: Value hunter
items.author: AQR research
items.rule: Compare valuation measures within a consistent asset universe.

items.name: Quality first
items.author: Asness · Frazzini · Pedersen
items.rule: Contrast higher-quality firms with lower-quality firms using documented quality measures.

items.name: Low beta
items.author: Frazzini · Pedersen
items.rule: Combine scaled low-beta exposure with an offsetting high-beta leg.
items.dataNeeded: Benchmark returns; rolling beta; leverage costs

items.name: Carry basket
items.author: AQR research
items.rule: Compare expected carry while separating carry income from price changes.

items.name: Correlation breaker
items.author: AQR research
items.rule: Study low-correlation exposure separately from volatility when building defensive portfolios.

items.name: All weather
items.author: Bridgewater
items.rule: Balance exposure to different growth and inflation environments.
items.dataNeeded: Multi-asset returns; macro exposure; risk estimates

items.name: Minimum variance
items.author: MSCI methodology
items.rule: Minimize estimated portfolio variance subject to explicit portfolio constraints.

items.name: Risk balance
items.author: AQR research
items.rule: Allocate by risk contribution rather than equal cash amounts.
items.sourceTitle: AQR · Risk Parity, Risk Management and the Real World

items.name: Cluster balance
items.author: Marcos López de Prado
items.rule: Cluster correlated assets, order the covariance matrix, then allocate recursively.
items.sourceTitle: Marcos López de Prado · Building Diversified Portfolios

items.name: Volatility brake
items.author: Moreira · Muir
items.rule: Reduce risk exposure when estimated volatility rises.

items.name: Conviction blend
items.author: Fischer Black · Robert Litterman
items.rule: Combine equilibrium expected returns with investor views and their uncertainty.
items.sourceTitle: Black & Litterman · Global Portfolio Optimization (original paper)

items.name: Fractional Kelly
items.author: J. L. Kelly · Edward Thorp
items.rule: Size exposure using estimated edge and payoff risk; fractional sizing reduces aggressiveness.
items.dataNeeded: Win probability; payoff distribution; tail risk

items.name: Equal basket
items.author: MSCI methodology
items.rule: Reset constituent weights to equal amounts at a defined rebalance.

items.name: Dual momentum
items.author: Gary Antonacci
items.rule: Select relative strength only while the absolute trend condition also holds.
items.sourceTitle: Gary Antonacci · Dual, Relative & Absolute Momentum

items.name: Monthly trend
items.author: Meb Faber
items.rule: At monthly checkpoints, compare price with its 10-month moving average.
items.dataNeeded: Ten or more monthly closes; cash return
items.sourceTitle: Meb Faber · A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation

items.name: Pairs spread
items.author: Gatev · Goetzmann · Rouwenhorst
items.rule: Select historically similar normalized price paths and examine spread divergence.
items.dataNeeded: Aligned history; pair formation; borrow; costs

items.name: Residual revert
items.author: Avellaneda · Lee
items.rule: Remove principal-component exposures and model mean reversion in residual returns.
items.dataNeeded: Large return panel; factor fit; residual history
items.sourceTitle: Avellaneda & Lee · Statistical Arbitrage in the U.S. Equities Market

items.name: Sector neutral
items.author: Avellaneda · Lee
items.rule: Use sector ETF exposures to isolate residual trading signals.
items.sourceTitle: Avellaneda & Lee · Statistical Arbitrage in the U.S. Equities Market

items.name: Turtle breakout
items.author: Richard Dennis · William Eckhardt; Curtis Faith rules
items.rule: Use the short breakout system with its prior-trade filter, volatility sizing and exits.
items.dataNeeded: OHLC; ATR; 20-day entry; 10-day exit; prior outcomes

items.name: Long breakout
items.author: Richard Dennis · William Eckhardt; Curtis Faith rules
items.rule: Use the longer breakout system with volatility sizing and channel exits.

items.name: Squeeze watch
items.author: John Bollinger
items.rule: Measure narrowing volatility bands to detect compression, not breakout direction.

items.name: Band reversal
items.author: John Bollinger
items.rule: Combine band position with confirmation instead of treating a band touch as an order.

items.name: Anchor reclaim
items.author: Brian Shannon
items.rule: Accumulate volume-weighted price from a meaningful event anchor.
items.dataNeeded: Trade price and volume; exact anchor event

items.name: Dip reset
items.author: Larry Connors
items.rule: Use the published short-RSI pullback sequence together with its trend and exit filters.
items.dataNeeded: Daily closes; RSI(2); long-term trend filter

items.name: Swing context
items.author: Linda Raschke
items.rule: Study swing structure together with trade location and market-profile context.
items.dataNeeded: Intraday OHLC; volume profile; reference levels
items.sourceTitle: Linda Raschke · Swing techniques and market profile lectures

items.name: Triple screen
items.author: Alexander Elder
items.rule: Separate higher-timeframe trend, intermediate pullback and lower-timeframe entry.
items.sourceTitle: Alexander Elder · Triple Screen and indicator documentation

items.name: Range reset
items.author: Larry Williams; TradingView reference
items.rule: Locate the closing price within a recent high-low range.

items.name: Trend template
items.author: Mark Minervini
items.rule: Screen for aligned moving averages and established upward price structure.
items.dataNeeded: Long historical prices; moving averages; relative strength
items.sourceTitle: Minervini · Published workshop review and trend templates

items.name: Momentum cross
items.author: Gerald Appel; TradingView reference
items.rule: Track the difference between two exponential averages and its signal line.
items.dataNeeded: Closed candles; fast/slow EMA; signal EMA

items.name: RSI reset
items.author: J. Welles Wilder; TradingView reference
items.rule: Compare smoothed upward and downward moves to measure relative momentum.

items.name: Trend strength
items.author: J. Welles Wilder
items.rule: Measure directional movement strength and distinguish it from direction.

items.name: Trailing dots
items.author: J. Welles Wilder
items.rule: Move a trailing stop reference with trend acceleration and extreme prices.

items.name: Range momentum
items.author: George Lane; TradingView reference
items.rule: Compare close with its recent range and smooth the oscillator.

items.name: Cloud trend
items.author: Goichi Hosoda; TradingView reference
items.rule: Combine midpoint lines, displaced spans and cloud position for trend context.

items.name: Supertrend
items.author: Olivier Seban; TradingView reference
items.rule: Switch trend state using volatility-adjusted bands and closing-price conditions.

items.name: Channel break
items.author: TradingView implementation
items.rule: Enter on an upper-channel cross and reverse on a lower-channel cross.

items.name: Range breakout
items.author: Richard Donchian
items.rule: Track the highest high and lowest low in a rolling lookback.

items.name: Flow acceleration
items.author: Marc Chaikin
items.rule: Subtract slow from fast EMA of the accumulation/distribution line.

items.name: Volume lead
items.author: Joseph Granville
items.rule: Add or subtract volume according to close-to-close direction.

items.name: Money pressure
items.author: Marc Chaikin
items.rule: Weight volume by closing location within the bar's high-low range.

items.name: Money flow
items.author: Gene Quong · Avrum Soudack
items.rule: Separate positive and negative typical-price money flow into a bounded index.

items.name: Force pulse
items.author: Alexander Elder
items.rule: Multiply price change by volume and smooth the result.

items.name: Accumulation line
items.author: Marc Chaikin
items.rule: Accumulate volume weighted by the close's position inside each bar.

items.name: Session reclaim
items.author: TradingView reference
items.rule: Compare price with cumulative volume-weighted price within a defined session.
items.dataNeeded: Trade prices; volume; explicit session boundary

items.name: Volume shelves
items.author: TradingView reference
items.rule: Aggregate traded volume by price level over a chosen window.

items.name: Klinger flow
items.author: Stephen Klinger
items.rule: Compare smoothed volume force across short and long horizons.

items.name: Easy move
items.author: Richard Arms
items.rule: Relate midpoint price movement to the bar's volume and range.

items.name: Price-volume trend
items.author: TradingView reference
items.rule: Accumulate volume multiplied by proportional price change.

items.name: Time slice
items.author: Interactive Brokers reference
items.rule: Distribute execution over time toward a time-weighted benchmark.
items.dataNeeded: Order budget; schedule; fresh quotes; execution receipts

items.name: Volume slice
items.author: Interactive Brokers reference
items.rule: Schedule execution using the expected volume profile.
items.dataNeeded: Intraday volume curve; fills; remaining budget
items.sourceTitle: Interactive Brokers · Order types and algorithms

items.name: Participation
items.author: Interactive Brokers reference
items.rule: Limit participation to a chosen share of observed market volume.
items.dataNeeded: Live volume; participation cap; order state
items.sourceTitle: Interactive Brokers · Order types and algorithms

items.name: Arrival price
items.author: Interactive Brokers reference
items.rule: Trade toward the arrival-price benchmark subject to urgency and risk preferences.
items.dataNeeded: Arrival snapshot; live quotes; fills; urgency
items.sourceTitle: Interactive Brokers · Order types and algorithms

items.name: Impact balance
items.author: Robert Almgren · Neil Chriss
items.rule: Balance market-impact costs against price risk while scheduling liquidation.
items.dataNeeded: Impact estimates; volatility; inventory; time horizon

items.name: Adaptive limit
items.author: Interactive Brokers
items.rule: Adapt order handling to available liquidity and selected urgency.
items.sourceTitle: Interactive Brokers · Order types and algorithms

items.name: Quiet accumulation
items.author: Interactive Brokers
items.rule: Break a parent order into smaller parts with configurable timing and conditions.
items.sourceTitle: Interactive Brokers · Order types and algorithms

items.name: Inventory maker
items.author: Marco Avellaneda · Sasha Stoikov
items.rule: Adjust quotes for inventory, risk aversion and market conditions.
items.dataNeeded: Order book; inventory; fill model; volatility
items.sourceTitle: Avellaneda & Stoikov · High-frequency trading in a limit order book

items.name: Route optimizer
items.author: Uniswap
items.rule: Compare split routes and gas costs when searching for swap execution.
items.dataNeeded: Pool state; amount quotes; gas model; route graph

items.name: Batch match
items.author: CoW Protocol
items.rule: Collect trade intents and let solvers compete over settlement solutions.
items.dataNeeded: Signed intents; solver bids; settlement contracts

items.name: Range liquidity
items.author: Uniswap v3/v4
items.rule: Concentrate liquidity inside an explicitly selected price range.
items.dataNeeded: Pool ticks; price; liquidity; fee accrual

items.name: Weighted pool
items.author: Balancer
items.rule: Hold multiple assets under a weighted invariant while swaps generate fees.
items.dataNeeded: Pool weights; balances; fees; contract state

items.name: Stable pool
items.author: Michael Egorov / Curve
items.rule: Use a specialized invariant for assets expected to trade near parity.

items.name: Lend yield
items.author: Aave
items.rule: Supply assets to a lending market and earn its variable supply rate.
items.dataNeeded: Reserve state; utilization; supply APR; caps

items.name: Curated lending
items.author: Morpho
items.rule: Allocate a vault across permitted lending strategies under caps and controls.
items.dataNeeded: Vault allocations; caps; adapter state; fee terms

items.name: Strategy vault
items.author: Yearn
items.rule: Represent a yield strategy through standardized deposit, report and withdrawal accounting.
items.dataNeeded: Strategy positions; reports; share accounting; withdrawal conditions

items.name: Fixed maturity
items.author: Pendle
items.rule: Buy principal tokens and hold to maturity under the underlying redemption terms.
items.dataNeeded: PT price; maturity; redemption asset; fees

items.name: Yield exposure
items.author: Pendle
items.rule: Buy the right to an underlying asset's yield until maturity.

items.name: Hedged carry
items.author: Ethena
items.rule: Hedge approved spot collateral with derivatives while managing backing and funding.
items.dataNeeded: Collateral; hedge exposure; funding; custody; basis

items.name: Atomic arb
items.author: Aave flash-loan primitive
items.rule: Borrow and repay within one transaction; a profitable route must cover fees and gas.
items.dataNeeded: Executable cross-pool quotes; callback contract; repayment; gas

items.name: Funding carry
items.author: Deribit mechanics; Rally adaptation
items.rule: Pair spot exposure with an offsetting perpetual and account for changing funding.
items.dataNeeded: Spot/perp prices; funding history; fees; margin

items.name: Basis carry
items.author: Deribit market data reference
items.rule: Compare a dated future's premium with financing and holding costs.
items.dataNeeded: Spot; dated futures; expiry; financing; fees

items.name: Position build
items.author: Deribit metrics; Rally interpretation
items.rule: Observe changes in open interest alongside price; neither reveals trader intent alone.

items.name: Liquidation buffer
items.author: Perpl API; Rally risk rule
items.rule: Compare current position margin and venue risk parameters with liquidation conditions.

items.name: Spent profit
items.author: Renato Shirakashi; Glassnode definition
items.rule: Compare spent outputs' value when spent with their value when created.

items.name: Cost-basis cycle
items.author: Mahmudov · Puell; Glassnode definition
items.rule: Compare market capitalization with realized capitalization.

items.name: Unrealized cycle
items.author: Glassnode methodology
items.rule: Normalize the gap between market and realized capitalization.

items.name: Dormant move
items.author: Glassnode methodology
items.rule: Weight spent coin volume by the time it was dormant.

items.name: Exchange flow
items.author: Glassnode exchange metrics
items.rule: Compare exchange-labelled inflows and outflows within the same period.

items.name: Smart money flow
items.author: Nansen
items.rule: Rank token accumulation or distribution for an explicitly defined labelled-wallet cohort.
items.dataNeeded: Licensed wallet labels; token flows; supported chain

items.name: Graph reputation
items.author: Page · Brin · Motwani · Winograd
items.rule: Propagate graph importance through weighted links with a teleportation term.
items.dataNeeded: Follow graph; weighted edges; anti-Sybil controls
items.sourceTitle: Brin & Page · The Anatomy of a Large-Scale Hypertextual Web Search Engine

items.name: Curator graph
items.author: Jon Kleinberg
items.rule: Score hubs and authorities through their mutual link structure.

items.name: Your network
items.author: Taher Haveliwala
items.rule: Bias graph traversal toward a user's seeds or topics.
items.dataNeeded: User seeds; topic graph; block filters

items.name: Token search
items.author: Stephen Robertson · Hugo Zaragoza reference
items.rule: Rank text using term relevance, saturation and document-length normalization.
items.dataNeeded: Tokenized text; document frequencies; exact contract identity

items.name: Signal blend
items.author: Cormack · Clarke · Büttcher
items.rule: Combine ranked lists using reciprocal rank contributions.
items.sourceTitle: Cormack, Clarke & Büttcher · Reciprocal Rank Fusion

items.name: Fresh angles
items.author: Carbonell · Goldstein
items.rule: Balance relevance with dissimilarity to already selected items.
items.dataNeeded: Relevance scores; content similarity; selected list

items.name: Taste match
items.author: Rendle · Freudenthaler · Gantner · Schmidt-Thieme
items.rule: Learn pairwise preferences from implicit interaction feedback.
items.dataNeeded: Consent-aware interactions; negative sampling; held-out evaluation
items.sourceTitle: Rendle et al. · Bayesian Personalized Ranking

items.name: Explore balance
items.author: Auer · Cesa-Bianchi · Fischer
items.rule: Choose options using estimated reward plus an uncertainty bonus.

items.name: Adaptive discovery
items.author: Thompson; Russo et al. tutorial
items.rule: Sample uncertain reward models to balance learning and exploitation.
items.sourceTitle: Russo et al. · A Tutorial on Thompson Sampling

items.name: Learned ranking
items.author: Christopher Burges / Microsoft Research
items.rule: Train boosted trees with ranking-oriented gradients.

items.name: Network effects
items.author: Chris Dixon / a16z crypto
items.rule: Examine how incentives attract participants before network utility becomes established.
items.dataNeeded: Active users; retention; reward spending; network activity
items.sourceTitle: a16z crypto · Token incentives and network effects

items.name: Builder cycle
items.author: a16z research
items.rule: Study the relationship among prices, interest, developer activity and innovation.
items.dataNeeded: Market cycle; developer activity; product adoption

items.name: Token lens
items.author: a16z crypto
items.rule: Classify token designs before choosing the metrics used to evaluate them.
items.dataNeeded: Token purpose; control; value source; rights
items.sourceTitle: a16z crypto · Seven canonical token categories

items.name: Fee value
items.author: Token Terminal metrics; Rally screen
items.rule: Distinguish end-user fees from protocol revenue before comparing valuations.
items.dataNeeded: Comparable fees; revenue; token value; period

items.name: Revenue pulse
items.author: DefiLlama metrics; Rally screen
items.rule: Track protocol-retained revenue separately from gross user fees.
items.dataNeeded: Protocol fees; retained revenue; holder revenue

items.name: Developer pulse
items.author: Electric Capital
items.rule: Track developer participation with documented repository and contributor coverage.

items.name: Unlock radar
items.author: Tokenomist data; Rally rule
items.rule: Track scheduled releases of token supply against circulating supply and liquidity.
items.dataNeeded: Vesting schedule; float; recipient type; liquidity
items.sourceTitle: Tokenomist · Official CLI and unlock analysis

items.name: Curve radar
items.author: nad.fun data; Rally rule
items.rule: Observe curve progress changes at consistent timestamps with real trades.
items.dataNeeded: Curve state snapshots; trades; exact token address

items.name: Graduation watch
items.author: nad.fun V2 events; Rally rule
items.rule: Verify migration events and the resulting DEX market before surfacing tradability.
items.dataNeeded: Finalized events; token/pool mapping; fresh executable quote

items.name: Book pressure
items.author: Kuru order book; Rally rule
items.rule: Compare bid and ask depth within a fixed price band and quote size.
items.dataNeeded: Order-book snapshot; sequence; price band; intended amount
